title: status: [N pending] on topics is a false positive for the session that wrote them
description:
Symptom: csnotes status shows '[2 pending]' / '[4 pending]' on topics (data-structures, oop, java in the SU vault) even though nothing is out of sync. The same warning also goes into _session.md via workspace.rs ~L1343 ('Pending sessions (processed after last update)'), so the tutor sees it too and may waste time on it.

Cause: audit/reindex.rs ~L87-104 marks a session pending for a topic if processed_at > topic.last_updated && topics_updated contains the topic. But the two timestamps come from different moments of the same session:
- notes' frontmatter last_updated = Utc::now() at merge time: commit_cmd.rs ~L173 for an in-session 'csnotes commit', or process.rs ~L321 in teardown;
- SessionEntry.processed_at = a later Utc::now() set at the end of teardown (process.rs ~L886).
So the session that wrote the notes is always 'after' them. Observed in SU vault: data-structures notes 08-26 16:17:07 vs sessions 08-19/08-24 processed 16:36:01 (about 19 min, probably an in-session commit); java 21:04:09 vs 21:04:41.

Fix options (pick one):
a) Add SessionEntry.started_at (serde default None for old manifests). Compare against the start: pending only if the topic hasn't changed since the session began. Most correct, but old entries need a fallback.
b) Thread one 'now' through the whole teardown and every in-session commit of that workspace (e.g. take it from WorkspaceMeta.started_at) so notes and session share a timestamp, and change > to a strict comparison against that.
c) Cheapest: skip sessions whose processed_at falls within the same teardown window. Fragile; not recommended.
Leaning (a). For existing manifests with no started_at, the warning has to be suppressed or fall back to some fixed window, otherwise the false positives stay until the notes are re-stamped.

Test: reindex fixture where a session's processed_at is 30s and 20min after its own notes' last_updated → not pending; a session that lists a topic but whose notes predate session start → pending (existing tests in reindex.rs ~L278-340 should keep passing).

Not a cleanup item: the user's SU vault has no real desync, verified 2026-10-21.
